name: Resource-based trust policy (Principal + sts:AssumeRole) - not an identity escalation
note: A role trust policy declares WHO may assume a role. It is a resource-based policy attached to the role, not an identity policy granting the analyzed principal new powers.
rationale: The presence of a Principal element makes this a resource-based (role trust) policy, not an identity policy. It grants the named external principal (account 444455556666, gated by an ExternalId) the ability to assume THIS role; it grants the analyzed subject nothing. sts:AssumeRole appearing here is the assumed-by direction, not an assume-expansion capability held by an identity, so identity-escalation findings (ASSUME-ROLE-EXPANSION, PASSROLE-*, DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN, CREDENTIAL-CREATION) MUST NOT fire. Ref: AWS docs, 'Identity-based policies and resource-based policies' + 'How IAM roles differ from resource-based policies' (trust policy defines who can assume the role).
